The issuer exhibits solid profitability with an operating income of $979M (9% margin) and a robust equity base of $25,838M with high retained earnings. However, the balance sheet reveals a very weak liquidity position, characterized by a current ratio of 0.59 (current liabilities of $21,864M significantly exceeding current assets of $12,951M) and a relatively high leverage ratio (total liabilities-to-equity of 1.76). These mixed factors—strong overall scale and profitability tempered by substantial short-term refinancing risks—align with a mid-investment grade rating.

DECISION: BBB
